name: Pigeon
long_description:
Pigeon is a relationship based technology platform that facilitates the creation and management of loans between friends, family, loved ones, and anyone who trusts one another.

By providing smarter ways for people to mix money with their relationships, Pigeon seeks to empower individuals to borrow and lend money with the people they trust.
one_liner: Simplifying loans with your friends & family.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Hey! I've been blessed to have grown up in places as different as Alaska and South Africa. My main hobby is reading -- particularly history and science fiction.

I started my first company, TruePublic, in 2016 to better understand public opinion from young Americans. We were able to have a lot of success and also learned a lot of hard lessons I love to share.

I'm now building Base, a tech-powered social club helping people find deep connection.
